writeup: TIC 257773097 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 9.890459 days and a primary eclipse depth of 15.89 percent. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected the system with a signal-to-noise ratio of 1882.7, while pixel-level imaging confirmed the eclipse signature with a peak signal-to-noise of 74.2. A secondary eclipse was detected at 7.0 sigma significance near orbital phase 0.49. The system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate. However, alternating eclipses show significantly different depths - a pattern suggesting the true orbital period is twice what initial analysis indicated. This data quality flag remains open and should be considered when evaluating this candidate.
